season.evidence: Stored text late Jul-Sep. Mountaineers lists it as a rarely done glacier/alpine climb; a July 2026 party there turned around over unsafe early-season glacier transition. Only one Peakbagger ascent (Jun 20).

otherTracksConsidered.why: June 20 2026, a multi-peak traverse of the Kindy Creek drainage including Snowking (link-up), via snow and the NE ridge; June is also more than a month before the stored late-July start, and the start is 535 m from our pin.

notes: Mountaineers presents this as a glacier/alpine climb, our record calls it a Class 3 scramble; worth review.
